name: nxsched_get_tcb

ownership.argument: Companion to nxsched_foreach: pid to TCB. Recorded because the module may prefer resolving its own pid over walking.

provenance.source: Under the critical section, indexes the pid hash (0x200B24B0, count 0x200B24AC) as bucket[ (count - 1) & pid ] and returns the TCB only when its pid field at +44 equals the requested pid. 44 callers, including sched_get_stackinfo.

notes: Companion to nxsched_foreach: pid to TCB. Recorded because the module may prefer resolving its own pid over walking.
